en.title: UN Disability Rights Convention Marks 20 Years with Global Policy Focus
en.summary: The European Union and European Disability Forum highlighted the 20th anniversary of the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities at a COSP side event, emphasizing the role of disability organisations in shaping policy. A district court ruled in favor of the Guam Department of Education superintendent in an accessibility lawsuit concerning Southern High School, affirming compliance. Meanwhile, Myrtle Beach approved a free automated beach wheelchair program, and Texas launched an accessible standardized web design system for agency sites.

highlights.title: 20 Years of the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities: COSP Side Event Highlights Role of Organisations of Persons with Disabilities
District Court sides with GDOE superintendent in Southern High accessibility case
Myrtle Beach approves free automated beach wheelchair program - WPDE
Texas launches accessible, standardized web design system to modernize agency sites - StateScoop

zh-TW.title: 聯國殘疾人權利公約二十週年紀念
zh-TW.summary: 歐盟與歐洲殘疾人論壇在COSP側會中紀念《殘疾人權利公約》二十週年，討論殘疾人組織在政策制定中的角色。地方法院支持關島教育總監在南部高中無障礙訴訟中的立場，確認符合無障礙要求。米特爾海灘批准免費自動化海灘輪椅計畫，德州推出可訪問標準化網頁設計系統以現代化機構網站。

highlights.title: 《殘疾人權利公約》二十週年：COSP 側凸顯殘疾人組織的角色
地方法院支持GDOE總監在南部高中無障礙案件中的立場
